BiblicalUsage: Ethan the son of Kishi stands among the sons of Merari, on the left hand, in the service of song. One verse names him, and the family line is kept.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the singers' families are kept in the record, and Kishi's son Ethan sang before the ark.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
